/care-navigation/.a: The WellGen Care Navigation service, provided through the WellGen Care Navigation Center, offers dedicated post-discharge support to help patients heal well and feel safe and confident during the important recovery period at home after leaving the hospital.

Healing does not stop when you leave the hospital. The time spent at home is a critical part of recovery, and the Care Navigation Center helps patients avoid problems, follow their care plan, and achieve better long-term health outcomes.

/care-navigation/.q: What should patients focus on after leaving the hospital to support their recovery?
/care-navigation/.a: Patients should follow their discharge instructions carefully by taking medicines exactly as prescribed, watching for any new or worsening symptoms, attending all follow-up appointments, staying active only as recommended by their doctor, getting enough rest, drinking plenty of water, and eating healthy foods. Small consistent steps like taking medication on time and calling with questions can significantly improve recovery.

Transitional Care Management (TCM) refers to structured visits that occur after hospital discharge. These visits are designed to promote continuity of care, prevent avoidable complications, and support long-term health through careful coordination and monitoring.

/care-navigation/.q: What can a patient expect during a TCM visit?
/care-navigation/.a: During a TCM visit, the provider will review your hospitalization and discharge summary, perform medication reconciliation to ensure accuracy and safety, assess your current health status and recovery progress, clearly explain your ongoing care plan and next steps, and coordinate any needed referrals, diagnostic testing, or additional follow-up services.

/care-navigation/.q: When should a TCM visit be completed after hospital discharge?
/care-navigation/.a: TCM visits should be completed within 30 days of your hospital discharge to ensure timely support and continuity of care.

/care-navigation/.q: Where can I schedule a TCM visit or follow-up appointment?
/care-navigation/.a: TCM visits and follow-up appointments can be scheduled at any WellGen Health clinic. Selecting a clinic close to home often makes follow-up care more convenient and helps maintain connection with your care team.

/care-navigation/.q: How does the Care Navigation Center assist with scheduling and transitions?
/care-navigation/.a: The WellGen Care Navigation Center helps with clinic selection, appointment scheduling, and overall coordination. This support prevents delays in care and ensures a smooth transition from hospital to home or post-acute settings.

/care-navigation/.q: What specific types of help can the Care Navigation Center provide?
/care-navigation/.a: The Care Navigation Center can assist with scheduling a TCM visit within 30 days of discharge, booking or adjusting primary care appointments, reviewing discharge and medication instructions, coordinating care across WellGen Health clinics, helping with nursing home or post-acute care coordination, and guiding you through post-hospital recovery with confidence.

/care-navigation/.q: What is the direct phone number for the WellGen Care Navigation Center?
/care-navigation/.a: The WellGen Care Navigation Center can be reached directly at (214) 398-4690. The team is available to support you and help with the next steps toward a safer, healthier recovery.

/care-navigation/.q: What are the main contact details for WellGen Health?
/care-navigation/.a: WellGen Health can be contacted by phone at (844) 886-7362 or by email at Info@wellgen-health.com. Their physical address is 8220 WALNUT HILL LN, STE 600, Dallas TX, 75231-4433.

/care-navigation/.q: How does WellGen Health ensure continuity of care after a patient leaves the hospital?
/care-navigation/.a: WellGen physicians and clinical care teams ensure seamless continuity of care by rounding regularly at partner facilities. This approach enables timely follow-up, effective medication management, and early identification of any clinical concerns.

/care-navigation/.q: Which facilities does WellGen Health serve or partner with for care?
/care-navigation/.a: WellGen Health serves or partners with Collinwood Nursing & Rehabilitation, Golden Acres Living and Rehabilitation, Lakeside Health and Wellness, Lakewest Assisted Living, Simpson Place Assisted Living & Skilled Nursing, Villages on MacArthur Skilled Care & Memory Care, and Landmark of Plano.

/care-navigation/.q: How can I book an appointment for TCM or primary care with WellGen Health?
/care-navigation/.a: Appointments can be booked online through the WellGen Health website using the available booking options or by contacting the Care Navigation Center for personalized assistance with scheduling TCM visits or primary care appointments. The site also features "Send Now" options for appointment requests.

/care-navigation/.q: What are the key benefits of using WellGen's Care Navigation and TCM services?
/care-navigation/.a: These services promote continuity of care, help prevent avoidable complications, support long-term health, ensure smooth transitions after hospital discharge, provide safe medication management, offer a dedicated support line, and give patients greater confidence during recovery.

/care-navigation/.q: Can the Care Navigation Center help if I need coordination for nursing home or post-acute care?
/care-navigation/.a: Yes, the Care Navigation Center can assist with nursing home or post-acute care coordination as part of their comprehensive post-discharge support.

/care-navigation/.q: Is there a detailed public list of all WellGen Health clinic addresses on the Care Navigation page?
/care-navigation/.a: The page states that WellGen Health has several clinic locations and that patients can choose any clinic for visits, with the Care Navigation Center helping select the most convenient one close to home. However, a complete enumerated directory of specific clinic addresses is not listed on this page.

/care-navigation/.q: Who should I contact if I have questions about my discharge instructions or medications after leaving the hospital?
/care-navigation/.a: Contact the WellGen Care Navigation Center at (214) 398-4690. They can review your discharge and medication instructions, answer questions, and help coordinate any needed follow-up care.

/charge-capture/.a: WellGen Charge Capture is a secure, user-friendly, and HIPAA-compliant mobile application purpose-built for healthcare providers. It is designed to streamline the charge capture process by enabling physicians and clinical staff to record and submit professional charges in real time directly at the point of care from any mobile device. The application digitizes the entire charge capture workflow, allowing users to record patient encounters, assign CPT and ICD-10 codes, and submit charges instantly anytime and anywhere, whether rounding in a hospital, visiting patients in a clinic, or working remotely.

/charge-capture/.q: What problems with traditional charge capture methods does WellGen solve?
/charge-capture/.a: Traditional charge capture methods are slow, error-prone, and often result in missed or delayed charges that directly impact a practice's revenue. WellGen eliminates these inefficiencies by digitizing the workflow, allowing users to say goodbye to paper superbills and end-of-day charge entry. Every patient encounter is documented accurately and submitted instantly, keeping the revenue cycle moving without interruption and preventing lost revenue from forgotten submissions.

/charge-capture/.q: What are the main benefits of using WellGen Charge Capture for healthcare providers?
/charge-capture/.a: The main benefits include accessing patient encounters and medical histories on the go, syncing captured charges with your billing system in real time, reducing audit risk with accurate and compliant documentation, expediting payer payments by minimizing charge lag, improving rounding efficiency with a mobile-first workflow, submitting charges instantly to eliminate delays and lost revenue, staying fully compliant with HIPAA regulations, capturing office visits, diagnoses, and procedures, and assigning CPT and ICD codes instantly from a mobile device. These features help ensure an efficient and controlled charge capture process, especially for large healthcare organizations.

/charge-capture/.q: What is the Digital Rounding List feature in WellGen Charge Capture?
/charge-capture/.a: The Digital Rounding List feature provides physicians with a real-time patient census list that is accessible directly on their phone. This patient list integrates with the charge capture functionality and syncs directly into the EHR system, helping improve rounding efficiency and ensuring all relevant patient information is available at the point of care.

/charge-capture/.q: How does the Integrated Data Entry feature work in WellGen Charge Capture?
/charge-capture/.a: The Integrated Data Entry feature allows users to manage associated patient facesheets, notes, and charges all on one robust system. It eliminates duplicate data entry and reduces errors through seamless EHR integration that syncs in real time, providing a streamlined experience for handling all related patient information and charges in a single place.

/charge-capture/.q: What is the Easy Patient Handoff feature and how does it function?
/charge-capture/.a: The Easy Patient Handoff feature enables users to seamlessly share patients with other physicians for handoff or weekend rounding using a single swipe. It ensures continuity of care with instant, secure patient transfers and real-time updates, making it simple to transfer responsibility while keeping all information current and accessible.

/charge-capture/.q: What does the Mobile Charge Capture functionality allow users to do?
/charge-capture/.a: The Mobile Charge Capture functionality allows users to submit charges to their EHR or PMS in seconds. It supports easily cloning previous charges or choosing from customized drill-downs, enabling providers to capture every billable encounter at the point of care and eliminate lost revenue from forgotten submissions. This works alongside the ability to assign CPT and ICD-10 codes instantly.

/charge-capture/.q: On which devices is the WellGen Charge Capture application available?
/charge-capture/.a: The WellGen Charge Capture application is available on mobile devices, desktops, and tablets, providing convenience and flexibility so that physicians and clinical staff can use it wherever they are working, whether in a hospital, clinic, or remotely.

/charge-capture/.q: Who is WellGen Charge Capture designed for?
/charge-capture/.a: WellGen Charge Capture is designed for healthcare providers, specifically physicians and clinical staff. It is purpose-built to support their daily workflows and is particularly suited for large healthcare organizations that need an efficient and controlled charge capture process to maintain revenue integrity and operational efficiency.

/charge-capture/.q: Is WellGen Charge Capture HIPAA compliant and secure?
/charge-capture/.a: Yes, WellGen Charge Capture is a secure and HIPAA-compliant solution. It prioritizes compliance with HIPAA regulations to protect patient information while enabling real-time charge submission and documentation at the point of care.

/charge-capture/.q: How does WellGen Charge Capture integrate with other systems?
/charge-capture/.a: WellGen Charge Capture integrates seamlessly with EHR and PMS systems. It syncs captured charges with billing systems in real time, supports direct integration of the patient list and charge capture data into the EHR, and allows submission of charges to EHR/PMS platforms quickly and accurately, reducing duplicate entry and errors.

/charge-capture/.q: What types of codes and patient information can be handled in WellGen Charge Capture?
/charge-capture/.a: Users can capture office visits, diagnoses, and procedures while assigning CPT and ICD-10 codes instantly from their mobile device. The application also provides access to patient encounters and medical histories on the go, along with management of facesheets, notes, and charges in one system.

/charge-capture/.q: How can someone learn more about WellGen Charge Capture or get started?
/charge-capture/.a: Users can book an appointment through the "Book an Appointment" sections on the page, which include "Send Now" options for inquiries. For more information or support, contact WellGen Health directly at phone number (844) 886-7362, email Info@wellgen-health.com, or visit their office at 8220 WALNUT HILL LN, STE 600, Dallas TX, 75231-4433.

/charge-capture/.q: Does the WellGen Charge Capture page include customer testimonials?
/charge-capture/.a: The page includes a Testimonials section stating that WellGen prides itself on putting the customer first and inviting visitors to hear what the WellGen family has to say. However, no specific testimonial quotes or customer stories are displayed on the page itself.

/charge-capture/.q: What is the overall goal of WellGen Charge Capture for healthcare organizations?
/charge-capture/.a: The overall goal is to ensure an efficient and controlled charge capture process for large healthcare organizations by providing a complete mobile-first solution. It helps eliminate inefficiencies from traditional methods, reduces missed or delayed charges, improves revenue cycle management, maintains compliance, and supports better continuity of care through features like real-time syncing, easy handoffs, and instant submissions.
